Machine analysis may describe evidence; it does not author human meaning.
SET authors order/weight/seams; it does not analyze sources or store source bytes.
LISTEN may lend map/context; it does not author LIVE topology or TWO DIAL composition.
READFIELD remains text-native; music-specific metrics do not become reading semantics.
Mood/emotion estimates are subjective/model evidence; never source truth.
SOURCE SPINE / Addressed Continuity is a contract, not a new app or universal UI.
No provider catalog, public social backend, DAW, Journey Ride, or new schema from a research task.
No agent-to-agent free chat for synchronization; exchange bounded packets and receipts.
